g.text: Round82: unadapted confirmation at common 3600-second caps
Markers are audited checkpoints; dashed lines only guide the eye. Missing physical U means no plotted gap.
All displayed arms returned normally; elapsed time includes startup and all native calls.
Fresh fixed draws from familiar recipes; shared CitiBike station source limits independence.
